health-entry.notes: Yellow fever rule as reported to WHO in 2022. WHO advises confirming with the embassy before travel.
conditional: Yellow fever certificate: Proof of vaccination against yellow fever is required for travellers aged 1 year or over arriving from countries with risk of yellow fever transmission, and for travellers having transited for more than 12 hours through an airport of a country with risk of yellow fever transmission

seasons-and-flow.climate: Wettest: April, May and June. Driest: September, October and November. Hottest: October (27.7°C average). Coolest: January (25.8°C average). Country-wide averages for 1991 to 2020; coasts, mountains and the far north or south can differ a lot.

visa-preparation.recheck_note: Not verified 2026-11-01: no Smartraveller advice. Suriname's e-visa/entry-fee portal (suriname.vfsevisa.com, run by VFS for the government) blocked fetches; snapshots show a US$50 single-entry entry fee plus US$8 service fee. Needs a direct government read.

laws.rule: There are severe penalties for all drug offences. Pack all luggage yourself and do not carry anything through customs for anyone else.
laws.heading: Illegal drugs penalties

laws.rule: Credit cards are not widely accepted outside major hotels. Check with your hotel whether it accepts credit cards. Some cash machines in Paramaribo will accept international credit and debit cards and dispense Surinamese dollars.
laws.heading: Money

local-law.note: From UK Government (FCDO) travel advice, written for British travellers; Smartraveller has no advice page for this place. Confirm with the place's own authorities.
